label: THIN
notes: Fixed canary prompts are static across days so that a daily-digest change means the endpoint's output changed, not the prompt.
The brief's example weekday prompt was replaced with a fixed-token probe for exactly that reason.
Context: post-Sep-14 absorption watch, DeepSeek first. Drift = the canary output hash changed. That is the only fact asserted.
THIN doctrine: never signed, never publisher-wired, never interpreted by machine.
hash_rule: sha256 over the exact response body text (the message content string), one hash per prompt; endpoint daily digest = sha256 of the sorted prompt-hash concatenation (hex digests sorted lexically, concatenated, no separator)

prompts.text: Reply with exactly: CANARY draco — nothing else.
Complete with one word: the capital of France is
What is 17 + 25? Reply with the number only.
List the first three prime numbers separated by commas, nothing else.
Describe the colour blue in exactly five words.
